title: 36-Layer Dual-Stopband Interference Filter Control
scientific_hypothesis: A 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack with optimized thicknesses can simultaneously achieve high visible transmittance (420-700 nm) and low transmittance in UV (355-365 nm) and NIR (1030-1080 nm) bands without violating the 20-350 nm thickness constraint.
design_principle: Recalled thin-film optics theory suggests that alternating high/low index layers create stopbands at quarter-wave optical thicknesses and their harmonics. By deviating from strict quarter-wave thicknesses and optimizing individually, multiple stopbands can be engineered while maintaining a passband.
proposed_topology: Substrate (Fused Silica) | Layer 1 (ta2o5) | Layer 2 (sio2) | ... | Layer 36 (sio2) | Air. Total 36 layers, alternating high/low index, starting with high index on substrate.
manufacturing_considerations: Individual layer thickness must remain within 20-350 nm
Alternating material sequence for stress balance
theory_basis: Recalled knowledge: High/low index contrast (Ta2O5/SiO2) enables strong interference effects.
Recalled knowledge: Quarter-wave stacks produce stopbands at design wavelength and odd harmonics.
Recalled knowledge: Non-periodic thickness optimization allows multi-band spectral shaping.
expected_advantages: High degrees of freedom (36 thickness variables) allow complex spectral shaping.
Alternating structure is manufacturable using standard deposition.
Control arm establishes baseline performance without literature bias.
known_risks: Ta2O5 optical data may not resolve in the registry (iteration_20 failed on material_data); if so, the route will fail.
Strict 20-350 nm thickness bounds may limit optimizer convergence compared to relaxed bounds suggested in feedback.
Recalled index values are approximate; actual dataset values will determine performance.
36 layers may approach stress limits not modeled in this optical-only simulation.
execution_request_english: Perform a thin-film optimization for a planar multilayer stack on a Fused Silica substrate. The stack consists of 36 layers alternating between Ta2O5 (Gao) and SiO2 (Gao), starting with Ta2O5 (Gao) on the substrate. Optimize the thickness of each of the 36 layers individually. Constraints: each layer thickness must be between 20 nm and 350 nm. Illumination: 0 degrees incidence, unpolarized. Wavelength targets: Maximize transmittance in 420-700 nm, minimize transmittance in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm. Use coherent transfer matrix method. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, and thicknesses_nm.
revision_reason: Continuation of control arm addressing material_data failure by reaffirming material names and adhering to thickness constraints while maintaining prior knowledge basis.
